data.narrative:
X-Bow Systems, a Series B-stage defense and security company, has raised $157M to date across its founding team of Jason Hundley, Mark Kaufman, and Maureen Gannon. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—operating in the same sector and stage.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base, applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $298M. Peer-median analysis examines 6 same-sector, same-stage comparables (Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, Defense Unicorns and Heven AeroTech each at $1.0B, and one additional peer). The median valuation across this set is $1.1B, with a range from $300M to $3.0B, reflecting heterogeneity in the cohort.

The triangulated valuation range spans $254M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $712M. The low bound reflects stage-progression methodology; the high bound approximates peer-median results. Key uncertainties include the relevance of the broad peer range ($300M–$3.0B spread), which suggests either significant performance differentiation among comparables or stage-definition inconsistencies. Additional clarity on X-Bow's revenue, growth trajectory, and market position relative to named peers would narrow this range materially.
